newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak VSZ sees SKK 1.3 bln 96 net profit.
newsitem.headline: Slovak VSZ sees SKK 1.3 bln 96 net profit.

text.p: Slovakia's largest steel producer VSZ a.s. on Friday said it expects to post an unconsolidated, 1996 after-tax profit of around 1.3 billion crowns, up some 100 million crowns from 1995.

VSZ spokesman Ladislav Jakubec told Reuters the preliminary results, which were some 80 to 100 million crowns higher than originally forecast were due in large part to steel and rolled steel production, totalling 3.4 million tonnes and 3.07 million tonnes respectively.
Jakubec said that the group's consolidated results according to international auditing standards will be released at the beginning of April.
Production of steel totalled 3.8 million tonnes in 1995.
VSZ said that post-recession stabilisation of the world steel markets in early 1996 also helped it achieve the higher-than-expected profit.
The company exported 70 percent of its overall production in 1996, mainly to European Union and countries in central and eastern Europe.
